description: Consolidated read-only convenience reference. All twelve faction command lists contain four options; matched-play armies choose two of these four. Per-faction profile files remain authoritative.

sourceRef.section: Faction Rule and Faction Commands subsections of each of the 12 faction entries

factionRule.name: Combined Arms
factionRule.effect: Coordinated Arms: When a friendly Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy also Engaged by a DIFFERENT friendly Unit, add +1 Attack die to its combined pool. Alternatively, when a friendly Unit makes a ranged Weapon Attack while wholly within 3" of another friendly Unit, add +1 Attack die to its combined pool; ranged benefit excludes Artillery, Vehicles, War Machines, and Large Assets. Max +1 die from this faction rule per Attack, regardless of supporting Units.
factionRule.knownIssue: Shares its name with the generic Doctrine 'Combined Arms' (rulebooks/chapters/02_wargame/03_non_faction_doctrines.md), which has a different, unrelated 5-Command effect table. Likely intentional thematic echo, not a merge.

factionCommands.name: Coordinated Advance
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit’s Movement activation, choose up to two friendly Units within Short of it (which may include the active Unit). Each selected Unit may immediately Move up to 2", ending legally. These are additional Moves, not refreshed activations; Disengage and Withdrawn rules still apply.

factionCommands.name: Covering Fire
factionCommands.effect: After a friendly Unit Disengages, choose a different friendly Unit within Short of it that has not yet used its Assault activation. That Unit immediately makes an eligible ranged Attack against the enemy left behind, consuming its normal Assault activation. This does not grant a second Attack.

factionCommands.name: Secure Ground
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit counts as one additional Unit for objective control until the end of the Round.

factionCommands.name: Coordinated Targeting
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares an Attack this Phase, choose Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. It gains that keyword for this Attack only, provided the target has the matching tag. Matching Anti ranks do not stack; use the highest. This Command adds its bonus dice once to the combined Unit Attack pool, not per Model.

factionRule.name: Unyielding
factionRule.effect: Once per Round, each friendly Core or Elite Unit reduces the first instance of Damage it suffers by 1, minimum 0. This applies after Saves and cannot reduce a Critical Injury.
factionRule.playtestNote: Compare restricting this trait to these Units versus allowing all friendly Units.

factionCommands.name: Stand Fast
factionCommands.effect: Improve one friendly Unit's Armor or an applicable Ward by one step until the end of the Phase.

factionCommands.name: Righteous Retaliation
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: After a friendly Unit survives a Melee Attack, it gains +3 Attack dice on its next eligible Melee Attack against the attacker. This bonus expires at the end of the following Round if unused; it applies once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

factionCommands.name: Heroic Intervention
factionCommands.effect: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an Attack, choose a different friendly Unit within Short of the attacked Unit. The chosen Unit may immediately Move up to 3" toward the attacked Unit, ending legally. It cannot use this Move as a free Disengage, and this does not change the declared Attack target or intercept the Attack.

factionCommands.name: Break Their Line
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Cavalry 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Entrenched
factionRule.effect: Friendly Units that did not Move during the preceding Movement Phase gain Tough 1 against Ranged attacks.

factionCommands.name: Hold the Line
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an Attack, it gains Tough 2 against the triggering Attack only. This does not persist for other Attacks.

factionCommands.name: Concentrated Volley
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next ranged Attack this Phase, provided it did not voluntarily Move in the preceding Movement Phase.

factionCommands.name: Prepared Position
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit's Movement activation, it may forgo its normal Move to gain Cover 2 against Ranged Attacks until the beginning of its next Movement activation. This is an explicit Cover benefit even without a barricade; no terrain is created. Disengaging or another voluntary Move this Round ends the benefit.

factionCommands.name: Counterbattery Orders
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Ranged 4 or Anti-Artillery 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Paths of the Wild
factionRule.effect: While a friendly Unit is already benefiting from Cover, it gains an additional Cover 1. This bonus does not create Cover eligibility by itself; ordinary Difficult Terrain rules apply.

factionCommands.name: Through the Wild
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit’s Movement activation, if unengaged and benefiting from Cover, it may Blink 6, ending legally in Cover granted by a different piece of terrain. After repositioning, it gains Concealed until the beginning of its next Movement activation or until Concealed ends normally (including Attacking, entering Engagement, or losing Cover). This is not a Move, Charge, or free Disengage.

factionCommands.name: Entangling Growth
factionCommands.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit within Medium of the active Unit. It either suffers Slow 2 on its next normal Move or cannot declare a Charge for the rest of this Round (choose one when using this Command).

factionCommands.name: Fade into the Wilds
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: After an Attack against a friendly unengaged Unit is completely resolved, that Unit may Move up to 2", ending legally. If it ends benefiting from Cover, it gains Concealed until the beginning of its next Movement activation or until Concealed ends normally. It cannot retroactively negate the triggering Attack or bypass Withdrawn and Disengage rules.

factionCommands.name: Cull the Flank
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Cavalry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Eager for Battle
factionRule.effect: Faction-specific Warclans Units gain Charge 2; generic Units recruited into Warclans instead gain Charge 1. Use the highest applicable Charge X, not the sum, unless another rule explicitly says otherwise. These bonuses affect Charge distance, not Impact. Printed higher Charge ranks on faction Units (such as Boar Riders Charge 3) still apply.

factionCommands.name: Get In There!
factionCommands.effect: When a different friendly Unit successfully completes a Charge, choose one unactivated friendly Unit within Short of the charger. It may immediately make its normal Charge activation, consuming its Assault activation for this Phase; it does not gain a second Charge.

factionCommands.name: Overwhelm
factionCommands.effect: The active multi-model Unit gains +1 Attack die per surviving Model, to a maximum of +6 Attack dice, on its next Melee Attack this Combat Phase. This bonus is added once to the combined Unit Attack pool, not multiplied again by its Models.

factionCommands.name: Keep Fighting!
factionCommands.effect: After destroying an enemy Unit in Engagement, the attacking Unit may Move up to 2" toward another enemy.

factionCommands.name: Crush Their Ranks
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Strength in Numbers
factionRule.effect: Friendly Units containing at least 5 Models gain Accurate 2.

factionCommands.name: Dirty Trick
factionCommands.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit within Medium of the active Unit during this Unit's Assault activation. Worsen that enemy's Armor or Evade by one step (choose one) until the end of this Assault Phase. This enemy debuff may affect later friendly Attacks during the Phase; it does not grant any additional activation.

factionCommands.name: Scurry Away
factionCommands.effect: During its own Movement activation, the active Unit may Disengage without becoming Withdrawn. It follows all other normal Disengage restrictions and does not gain an additional activation.

factionCommands.name: Mob Them!
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit’s Movement activation, choose up to two friendly Units (including the active Unit if desired) to Move up to 2" toward the same enemy within Medium of the active Unit. Each Move must end legally; this is a multi-unit support exception, not an activation refresh.

factionCommands.name: Strike the Exposed
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Support 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Endless Dead
factionRule.effect: The first time each Round an Undead Unit with more than one starting Model survives an Attack that defeats one or more of its basic Models, roll 1D6 for each Model defeated by that Attack. For each 6+, restore one defeated basic Model to that surviving Unit, up to its starting size, placing returned Models legally in Coherency. This passive effect may return Models while Engaged but cannot restore a completely destroyed Unit.

factionCommands.name: Rise Again
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit's Movement activation, choose a surviving, unengaged friendly Undead Unit within Short of the active Unit to restore one defeated basic Model, up to its starting size. Alternatively, once per battle, designate a completely destroyed, previously purchased friendly Undead Core Unit for return at the end of this Movement Phase, placing two of its original basic Models wholly within the friendly Deployment Zone in legal Coherency. This return consumes one normal reinforcement allowance for the Round; the returned Unit cannot activate, Charge, or control objectives that Round. Neither mode creates a free new Unit.

factionCommands.name: Death March
factionCommands.effect: The active eligible Undead Unit may immediately make an additional normal Move, ending legally. It cannot make a ranged Attack this Round; this does not refresh its Movement activation or remove Withdrawn.

factionCommands.name: The Dead Do Not Tire
factionCommands.effect: Remove Slow, Off-Balance, or one temporary Hit, Move, or Evade penalty from the active friendly Undead Unit. This cannot remove Withdrawn, accumulated Damage, or temporary Wounds.

factionCommands.name: Sever the Vanguard
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Cavalry 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Feast on the Fallen
factionRule.effect: Once per Round, after a friendly Unit defeats an enemy Model in Engagement, Heal 1 Damage from that Unit.

factionCommands.name: Blood Frenzy
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy Unit that has already lost at least one Model or has accumulated unsaved Damage, gain +1 Attack die per surviving Model, maximum +4 Attack dice, on that Attack. Add these dice once to the combined Unit pool.

factionCommands.name: Predatory Speed
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: After a friendly Unit destroys an enemy Unit, choose that victorious Unit or one other friendly Unit within Short (6") of it. The chosen Unit may Move up to 2", ending legally. This is not a free Disengage or another activation.

factionCommands.name: Mesmerize
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When an enemy Unit within Short (6") of a friendly Unique Unit declares an Attack against that Unique Unit, worsen the enemy’s Hit by one step for that triggering Attack only.

factionCommands.name: Cut Off the Leaders
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Hero 4 or Anti-Officer 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Incorporeal
factionRule.effect: Friendly Spirit Units gain Ward 6+ against Physical Damage, or their Ward is improved by 1 against incoming Physical damage. This effect is already marked on the faction datasheets and is not applied a second time to those printed Ward values.

factionCommands.name: Fade from Reality
factionCommands.effect: Improve one friendly Unit's applicable Ward by one step until the end of the Phase.

factionCommands.name: Spectral Passage
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit gains Move +2" and may move through terrain and Models during this Movement activation, finishing legally.

factionCommands.name: Haunting Presence
factionCommands.effect: Choose one enemy Unit within Short of the active Unit. Until the end of this Phase, that enemy cannot benefit from Cover or Cover X against Attacks; it loses Evade eligibility that comes solely from Cover, but keeps other sources of Evade. This does not worsen its printed Evade or remove terrain.

factionCommands.name: Haunt the Battleline
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Ranged 4 or Anti-Support 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Dark Bargain
factionRule.effect: Once per friendly Infernal Unit per Round, before resolving one of its rolls, that Unit may voluntarily take 1 temporary Wound to reroll up to two dice in that roll. The Unit cannot voluntarily exceed 2 pending temporary Wounds, cannot reroll any die more than once, and cannot reroll a Reckless roll. Temporary Wounds are pending Damage, not extra maximum Wounds; resolve using the core Damage and Defeat rules.

factionCommands.name: Unbound Power
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit's next eligible Attack this Assault Phase gains +2 Attack dice to its combined pool. If that Attack Blunders, the active Unit gains 1 temporary Wound as backlash. Mandatory backlash can exceed the voluntary 2-Wound limit; the temporary Wounds are converted when the Unit next suffers unsaved Damage.

factionCommands.name: Blood Offering
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit's Assault activation, it voluntarily takes 2 temporary Wounds, provided doing so would not put it above the voluntary limit of 2. Choose a different friendly Unit within Short (6") of it; that Unit's next eligible Attack this Round gains +3 Attack dice and Accurate 1. The bonus applies to one combined Attack pool and grants no additional activation.

factionCommands.name: Open the Rift
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit's Movement activation, designate one eligible already-purchased minor Infernal Unit in Reserve for placement at the normal end-of-Movement reinforcement step, following its summoning restrictions. This consumes one available normal reinforcement slot and cannot exceed the Round's allowance. The arriving Unit cannot activate in Movement, Charge, or control objectives this Round unless an explicit exception permits it.

factionCommands.name: Break the Defense
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Elite 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionCommands.name: Overchannel
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit’s next Spell Attack this Assault Phase gains +1 Damage. This changes Damage per successful unsaved Hit, not the number of Attacks; it does not affect a second Attack.

factionCommands.name: Counterspell
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an enemy Magic Attack or ability that allows Armor, Evade, or Ward Saves, reroll up to all natural 1s in that Unit's applicable Save roll against the triggering effect. Each die may be rerolled at most once. This does not change Saves that the effect does not permit.

factionCommands.name: Spatial Fold
factionCommands.effect: During its own Movement activation, the active unengaged Unit gains Blink 3 and may immediately reposition up to 3" following normal Blink rules, ending legally and unengaged. This does not count as a normal Move or grant another activation.

factionCommands.name: Disjoin the Formation
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Monster 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

factionRule.name: Massive Momentum
factionRule.effect: Faction-specific Titan Clans Units gain Impact 2 on successful Charges; generic Units recruited into Titan Clans instead gain Impact 1. Explicitly distinct printed Impact bonuses (such as Stampede) add to the faction bonus, but duplicate faction bonuses never stack. Charge distance is unchanged.

factionCommands.name: Thunderous Advance
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares an eligible Charge target within the normal 12" declaration limit, it may Move up to 3" toward that target, ending legally and unengaged, then must attempt the declared Charge. This additional Assault-phase Move is not a Disengage or a normal Charge and does not extend the declaration limit.

factionCommands.name: Smash Through
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares a Charge, its Charge Impact ignores the defending Unit’s Tough X during Armor Saves against that Impact only. Brace and ordinary Armor/Ward still apply; this does not improve the Unit's later melee Attack.

factionCommands.name: Roar of Dominance
factionCommands.effect: During the active Monster Unit's Assault activation, enemy Units cannot use Reaction Commands in response to that Monster's actions or Attacks until the end of this Assault activation. This does not stop a Reaction triggered by some other Unit's action.

factionCommands.name: Smash the Ranks
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.
